lines.text: The psalm calls all peoples to clap and shout to God, the great King over all the earth.
God subdues nations beneath His people and chooses their inheritance, the pride of Jacob, whom He loves.
God has ascended amid songs of mourning, the LORD with the sound of the horn.
The psalm says to sing praises to our King, for God reigns over the nations, seated on His holy throne.
The nobles of the nations assemble as the people of the God of Moses, and earth's shields belong to God.
